cameraPresetSelector.customTitle: Camera not in presets: enter sensor/focal specs to compute the footprint
cameraPresetSelector.manualTitle: No camera: set the line spacing directly (e.g. rover/lawnmower deck width)

enginePlanLegend.plannedRoute: Planned route (teal) - the route the engine calculated, with real turns.
enginePlanLegend.turnLoopsNote: Turn loops may extend outside the boundary - the vehicle needs turning room. To keep turns inside a legal area, mark a workspace polygon in the Area Editor.
enginePlanLegend.yourMission: Your mission (blue) - the waypoints that go to the drone. It skips the turn loops: a copter just turns in place at each line end.
enginePlanLegend.zones: {{count}} zones - the area is flown one numbered zone at a time. A color just means a different zone.

fleetSurveyPanel.drawFirst: Draw a survey polygon first, then split it across vehicles.
fleetSurveyPanel.footnote: Bands are non-overlapping; missions upload sequentially to each vehicle on any connected link. Timing deconfliction is out of scope here.
fleetSurveyPanel.title: Split survey across fleet

circular.description: Orbit a point of interest at fixed radius.
circular.name: Circular

corridor.description: Linear survey along a centerline (roads, rail, power lines, pipelines). Parallel strips with plane racetrack turns or copter on-the-spot turns.
corridor.name: Corridor

crosshatch.description: Two perpendicular grid passes. Higher photo density and improved 3D reconstruction over a single grid.
crosshatch.name: Crosshatch

grid.description: Boustrophedon lawnmower pattern. Parallel scan lines across the polygon with overshoot for turns.
grid.name: Grid

panorama.description: Capture a line (shoreline, cliff, frontage): the drawn line is the subject, the flight path is derived to the side, and the camera yaws onto the subject the whole way.
panorama.name: Panorama

perimeterFill.description: N perimeter passes followed by a grid fill of the interior.
perimeterFill.name: Perimeter Fill

spiral.description: Inward or outward spiral within the polygon.
spiral.name: Spiral

presetDropdown.title: Pick a preset (or stay with current settings)

surveyConfigPanel.addBranchTitle: Draw a branch centerline that forks off this corridor

altRef.terrainDesc: Altitude above terrain (AGL) at each point

surveyConfigPanel.branchDrawing: Click the map, double-click to finish
surveyConfigPanel.cameraOffTitle: Camera triggers only along the scan lines; off during the turn-arounds outside the boundary
surveyConfigPanel.corridorHint: Draw the centerline as a path (roads, rail, power lines). Strips run parallel to it; an odd strip count rides the centerline, even straddles it.

corridorMode.copterDesc: Multirotor: turns on the spot, no overshoot or turn loops
corridorMode.planeDesc: Fixed wing: strips get overshoot and racetrack turns at sharp bends

surveyConfigPanel.corridorOvershootHint: Flies this far past each strip end before turning, so the turn happens off the mapped line. Junctions are left alone. It also sets the size of the turn waypoints below.
surveyConfigPanel.crosshatchOffsetHint: Perpendicular pass flies {{altitude}} (+{{offset}}%) for better photogrammetry.
surveyConfigPanel.crosshatchSameAlt: Both passes at the same altitude. Raise to fly the second pass higher.
surveyConfigPanel.editBoundaryTitle: Edit the boundary - drag vertices on the map, then Done recomputes the waypoints
surveyConfigPanel.editingPolygon: Editing polygon - drag points on the map (zoom in to reach them).
surveyConfigPanel.enduranceHint: Usable flight time per battery (after your reserve). Drives the battery estimate.
surveyConfigPanel.externalEngineHint: {{engine}} picks each region's line direction and turn style itself, so the Angle, Overshoot and Turns controls don't apply. Use the engine parameters above (turn radius, waypoints, track width) to steer the plan.
surveyConfigPanel.externalMarginHint: Buffers the boundary before it is sent to the engine: positive grows coverage past the edge, negative keeps lines inside.
surveyConfigPanel.finishEditTitle: Finish editing and recompute the waypoints
surveyConfigPanel.flipLegsCorridorTitle: Fly the strips starting from the far side
surveyConfigPanel.flipLegsGridTitle: Fly the lines in the opposite order, starting from the far side
surveyConfigPanel.flyOnLeftTitle: Aircraft flies on the left side of the line (in drawing direction); camera faces the other way
surveyConfigPanel.flyOnRightTitle: Aircraft flies on the right side of the line (in drawing direction); camera faces the other way

groundPattern.reverseDesc: Drive forward then reverse: no U-turns (Ackermann/car-like rovers, needs ArduRover DO_SET_REVERSE support)

surveyConfigPanel.importAreaTitle: Import a boundary from a KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, or Shapefile (.shp / zipped)
surveyConfigPanel.importedAsCorridor: No polygon in that file, so the line was loaded as a corridor centreline.
surveyConfigPanel.invertPathCorridorTitle: Reverse the travel direction along the centerline
surveyConfigPanel.invertPathGridTitle: Enter every line from its other end
surveyConfigPanel.leadInHint: A straight run onto the first line, so the aircraft is lined up before it starts rather than still turning across the first photos.
surveyConfigPanel.lineOrderInOrderTitle: Fly them 1, 2, 3 in order, whether or not the turn fits
surveyConfigPanel.lineOrderSkipTitle: Skip lines so each 180° turn has room: 1, 3, 5 then 2, 4
surveyConfigPanel.lockShapeTip: Lock the shape so tuning the settings cannot move it
surveyConfigPanel.manualWidthHint: Sets line spacing directly. For ground vehicles (rover/lawnmower) where the corridor is the operating width, not a camera footprint.
surveyConfigPanel.marginHint: Buffers the boundary: positive grows coverage past the edge, negative keeps lines inside.
surveyConfigPanel.maxTurnHint: Bends sharper than this get racetrack turn waypoints so the plane re-enters the next leg aligned.
surveyConfigPanel.noHairpins: No bend on this centreline is that sharp, so none are added.
surveyConfigPanel.noPolygonHint: Click the Survey button on the map toolbar, then draw a polygon to plan a grid.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaCopterWarning: Copter: set WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR to 0 so mission yaw commands hold; otherwise the aircraft snaps toward each next waypoint instead.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaEditHelp: Editing the curve: click a point to select it - its tangent arms appear. Drag the square arm handles to shape the curve through that point (right-click an arm to reset it). Drag the point itself to move it, right-click to delete, click a faint dot or the dashed line to add a point.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaHint: The line you draw is what gets captured. The flight path is computed beside it, the highlighted band shows what fits in frame, and the camera turns to face the line at every waypoint.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaNeedsCamera: Panorama needs a real camera: the frame size at range drives the plan. Pick a camera preset instead of Manual corridor.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaTypeHint: Line-based capture along a subject. To plan an area survey instead, exit and pick another survey type from the Survey menu.
surveyConfigPanel.panoramaYawHint: The mission pans the camera smoothly: each leg carries a yaw command whose turn rate spreads the rotation across the whole leg.

pattern.corridorDesc: Follow a centerline (roads, rail, power lines, pipelines)

surveyConfigPanel.planByGsdTitle: Set target ground sample distance; altitude is derived
surveyConfigPanel.reverseHint: Mission inserts DO_SET_REVERSE between lines. Rover firmware must support it.
surveyConfigPanel.saveAreaTip: Save this area (shape and settings, no waypoints) so it can be reused in another mission or on another machine
surveyConfigPanel.saveCameraTitle: Save these specs as a named camera in the dropdown
surveyConfigPanel.savePresetTitle: Save current settings as a preset
surveyConfigPanel.shapeLockedTitle: Shape is locked - unlock to move vertices
surveyConfigPanel.smoothedOnCopter: Smoothed waypoints on a copter add many extra waypoints for turn curves it doesn't need; Corners is usually the better choice.
surveyConfigPanel.sourceBehind: The saved area "{{name}}" is now at rev {{latest}}; this survey was built from rev {{revision}}.
surveyConfigPanel.spiralInwardTitle: Start at perimeter, end at center
surveyConfigPanel.spiralOutwardTitle: Start at center, end at perimeter
surveyConfigPanel.splitAcrossFleetTitle: Split this survey across the connected fleet
surveyConfigPanel.splitAlongRouteTitle: One aircraft: each flight is a continuous stretch of the route, all lines included, so you finish a section then move along
surveyConfigPanel.splitByLinesTitle: Swarm: each flight takes some of the parallel lines over the whole route, so several aircraft work side by side
surveyConfigPanel.splitIntoFlightsTitle: Split into one battery-sized flight group per sortie; upload each from the table
surveyConfigPanel.standoffHint: Distance from the subject to the flight path. Together with altitude it sets the camera range, so it drives frame size and photo spacing.
surveyConfigPanel.startCornerHint: Moves the start corner. With the grid angle, these two reach all four corners, so the first line is the one nearest your launch point.
surveyConfigPanel.stripPlanSummary: {{order}} · each turn gets {{gets}} m, needs {{needs}} m at {{radius}} m turn radius.
surveyConfigPanel.stripPlanWide: The plane will roll out wide and miss the start of each line.
surveyConfigPanel.terrainFollowHint: Terrain follow - sample ground elevation at every waypoint and hold {{altitude}} above it (bakes absolute MSL altitudes, no onboard terrain data needed).
surveyConfigPanel.turnLoopWarning: Below {{min}}° each loop replaces a {{angle}}° corner with two turns of about {{turn}}°, which is the tighter manoeuvre. Raise it if the plane is overshooting the line.
surveyConfigPanel.turnRadiusTooTight: {{radius}} m turn radius looks too tight for a fixed wing at {{speed}} m/s: a level 30° bank turn needs about {{suggested}} m. The engine will plan turns the aircraft can't track.
surveyConfigPanel.turnsCopterTitle: Multirotor: turn on the spot, lines connect directly
surveyConfigPanel.turnsPlaneTitle: Fixed-wing: extend the shorter line end at each turn for a clean 180° racetrack turn
surveyConfigPanel.unlockShapeTip: Unlock the shape so it can be dragged again
surveyConfigPanel.zigzagHint: Standard zigzag pattern. Rover turns 180° at each line end.

surveyMapOverlay.clickToAddControlPoint: Click to add a control point
surveyMapOverlay.dragCurve: Drag to shape the curve · right-click to reset

corridorCopter.description: Branched corridors. Multirotor turns on the spot.
corridorCopter.name: Corridor (Copter)

corridorPlane.description: Roads, rail, power lines. Fixed-wing strips with racetrack turns.
corridorPlane.name: Corridor (Plane)

inspectionDetail.description: Small areas, low altitude, high GSD.
inspectionDetail.name: Inspection / Detail

mapOrtho.description: 2D map. Fast flight, single grid pass.
mapOrtho.name: Map / Orthomosaic

photogrammetry3d.description: Buildings, terrain meshes. Crosshatch + high overlap.
photogrammetry3d.name: 3D / Photogrammetry

roverMower.description: Ground vehicle. Set corridor width directly.
roverMower.name: Rover / Mower

surveyStartButton.areaEditorDesc: Full-window editor: multi-area, holes, KML import
surveyStartButton.areaSurveyDesc: Draw a polygon, fill it with a lawnmower grid
surveyStartButton.buttonTitle: Plan a survey: area (polygon grid) or corridor (centerline strips)
surveyStartButton.corridorSurveyDesc: Draw a centerline (roads, rail, power lines), strips run parallel
surveyStartButton.panoramaCaptureDesc: Draw the SUBJECT (shoreline, cliff, frontage); flight path, camera yaw and triggers are computed for you

airframe.copterDesc: Turns on the spot: no overshoot
airframe.planeDesc: Needs room to turn: overshoot and racetracks
airframe.vtolDesc: Surveys as a fixed wing; lift motors for takeoff and landing

finish.noneDesc: Stop at the last line, so another survey or waypoint can follow
finish.rtlDesc: Return to launch after the last line

launch.autoDesc: Vertical for a VTOL, otherwise a normal takeoff and RTL
launch.runwayDesc: Normal takeoff and return to launch
launch.verticalDesc: VTOL takeoff, VTOL land at home

surveyVehicle.noVehicleNote: No vehicle connected - pick an airframe to plan for

start.noneDesc: Launch manually, then switch to Auto. Also what a follow-on survey needs
start.takeoffDesc: Mission opens with a takeoff to the survey altitude

surveyVehicle.turnsCopter: turns on the spot, no overshoot
